name: Mini Radar

60181.name: TacW Guidance I
60181.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+8%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+3%</color>.

RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range.
